messages.content: When was the signing of the Treaty of Lisbon?

function.name: get_event_date
function.description: Retrieve the date of a historical event. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

message.content:
**Signing:**  
- **Date:** December 13, 2007  
- **Location:** Rome, Italy  

(The treaty was subsequently ratified by all EU member states and formally entered into force on December 1, 2009.)

The user asks "When was the signing of the Treaty of Lisbon?" They want the date when it was signed.

We can answer directly: It was signed on December 13, 2007 (in Rome). But we might also mention that it entered into force later. However they asked specifically about signing. So provide date and location.

But maybe use tool? There's no need; it's straightforward knowledge. We could still call get_event_date with event="Treaty of Lisbon" but that's unnecessary. It's fine to just respond.

Thus produce an answer: Signed on Dec 13, 2007 in Rome. Also note that it came into effect on Dec 1, 2009. Provide context.
